name: elvis-presley-debut-album
description: A young Memphis singer's first LP became the first rock and roll album to reach number one on the US album chart.

name: miles-davis-kind-of-blue
description: A modal jazz session with a sextet became the best-selling jazz record of all time and a touchstone for every genre.

name: dylan-freewheelin-album
description: A folk singer's second album mixed original songs of love and protest and made him the voice of a restless generation.

name: beach-boys-pet-sounds
description: A California band's studio-crafted masterpiece of lush orchestration pushed pop into art and inspired the Beatles.

name: beatles-sgt-pepper
description: The Beatles' studio-bound concept album, with its crowded cover collage, became the emblem of a countercultural moment.

name: beatles-abbey-road
description: The Beatles' last recorded album, with its medley and a zebra-crossing cover, became one of the most copied images in music.

name: led-zeppelin-iv-album
description: An untitled record with four runic symbols on the label held the band's most famous song and became a hard rock landmark.

name: bowie-ziggy-stardust-album
description: David Bowie's story of an alien rock star made glam theatre mainstream and turned its creator into a cultural icon.

name: pink-floyd-dark-side-album
description: A prism on a black sleeve covered a seamless concept album that stayed on the charts for an astonishing length of time.

name: springsteen-born-to-run-album
description: A New Jersey rocker poured his ambition into a wall-of-sound album about escape that made him a star overnight.

name: eagles-hotel-california-album
description: A Californian band's dark allegory of excess, built around a twin-guitar epic, became one of the era's biggest sellers.

name: fleetwood-mac-rumours-album
description: A band recorded an album about its own breakups and betrayals, and it became one of the best-selling records ever.

name: pink-floyd-the-wall-album
description: A double concept album about isolation, with a schoolyard chant and a towering story of a rock star, filled stadiums.

name: acdc-back-in-black-album
description: A hard rock band's tribute to its late singer, with a new frontman, became one of the best-selling albums of all time.

name: prince-purple-rain-album
description: A Minneapolis star's soundtrack to his own film blended funk, rock and pop and made him a global superstar.

name: u2-joshua-tree-album
description: An Irish band's stadium-sized record of American landscapes and spiritual yearning made them the biggest group in the world.

name: madonna-like-a-prayer-album
description: A pop star's boldest album mixed gospel, funk and confession, and its provocative title song caused a storm of controversy.

name: nas-illmatic-album
description: A young Queens rapper's compact debut, with tight verses over classic beats, became the benchmark for lyrical hip-hop.

name: radiohead-ok-computer-album
description: An English band's anxious, futuristic record about technology and alienation was hailed as a landmark of its decade.

name: lauryn-hill-miseducation-album
description: A former Fugees star's solo debut fused soul, reggae and hip-hop and won a record haul of Grammy Awards.

name: norah-jones-come-away-with-me-album
description: A quiet jazz-tinged debut from a young pianist became a surprise global hit and swept the Grammy Awards.

name: amy-winehouse-back-to-black-album
description: A British soul singer's second album, steeped in retro sound and raw heartbreak, made her a global star.

name: adele-21-album
description: A British singer's heartbreak album of big ballads became a worldwide best-seller and swept the Grammy Awards.

name: beyonce-surprise-album
description: A pop star released a full album with videos for every song, with no warning, rewriting how records are launched.

name: kendrick-to-pimp-a-butterfly-album
description: A Compton rapper's dense, jazz-and-funk-inflected album on race and fame was hailed as a defining record of its decade.

name: beyonce-lemonade-album
description: A visual album spanning many genres, built around themes of betrayal and healing, premiered as a film before its release.

name: billie-eilish-debut-album
description: A teenage singer's whispery, bass-heavy debut from a bedroom studio swept the major Grammy Awards.

name: taylor-swift-folklore-album
description: A pop star announced and released a hushed, indie-folk album within a single day, and it won the top Grammy.
